newsitem.title: UK: British cameraman who shot Vietnam footage dies.
newsitem.headline: British cameraman who shot Vietnam footage dies.

text.p: Alan Downes, a British cameraman who filmed one of the most famous images of the Vietnam War, died of cancer on Wednesday aged 58.
Downes shot the memorable footage of the American bombing of a village on Highway One in South Vietnam and a little girl, Kim Phuc, burnt by napalm running down the road to safety.
ITN, for whom Downes worked for 32 years, said in a statement he had won numerous awards for his work which included footage of the famine in Biafra.
"The memorable images he took have become part of contemporary television history," ITN's chief executive Stewart Purvis said.
